intent: Let the owner skip a required interview stage if they write why.

edit.summary:
I proposed one change, to `actions.skip_stage` in the `authoring` domain. The proposal is element `E-13-263d9845`, and it came back with 0 issues. It is still waiting for a person to confirm it. I didn't change `delivery`.

`skip_stage` already existed, but its description limited it to optional stages. The new description lets the owner skip a required interview stage too, as long as they write why. I also added a precondition, `skip-needs-reason`, that refuses a skip when the reason is missing or empty. That precondition is my addition to enforce "if they write why"; the request didn't spell it out. The action is still owner-only, a person must take it, and it still goes through the same kernel call and `record_skip` reply. Nothing else in the action changed.
